name: prokhorovka
title: Prokhorovka, Kursk
notes: July 1943 tank battle on open steppe. Built on the west half and mirrored across x (mirror-x) so the field is EXACTLY even — neither commander gets a structural edge. Features (rail line, two settlements, shelterbelts) appear as mirrored pairs. Synthetic source (no live GIS fetch), same as pointe-du-hoc; elevation is not modeled (the steppe is flat — the point of the location).
